title: IDF Drone Strike Kills Hamas Khan Younis Brigade Commander al-Yazouri
detail: An Israeli drone strike killed Mohammad Abdul Salam al-Yazouri ('Abu al-Haitham'), commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, while he was walking in the Al-Mawasi area west of Khan Younis around midnight between September 10 and 11, 2026. A Hamas company commander, Hudheifa Muammar, and another brigade member, Muhammad Bahjat Rashi, were also killed in the same strike. The IDF and Shin Bet said al-Yazouri had worked to rebuild the Khan Younis Brigade's capabilities after heavy wartime losses and had helped plan the October 7, 2023 attack; he had survived a previous assassination attempt while hiding in a tunnel with Yahya and Mohammed Sinwar in 2021.

media.caption: Israel says it killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander al-Yazouri in an Al-Mawasi drone strike, Sep 10-11, 2026

title: IDF Drone Strike Kills Rafah Brigade Sniper Commander Abu Libda in Hamad City
detail: An Israeli drone strike hit a vehicle in Hamad City, north of Khan Younis, on September 10, 2026, killing Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Libda, 33. The IDF and Shin Bet identified him as commander of a Hamas sniper cell in the group's Rafah Brigade, saying he 'carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip' aimed at harming Israeli civilians and IDF troops near the Yellow Line, in what the military called a systematic violation of the ceasefire. Palestinian sources said strikes in the area killed four people in total that evening, with additional drone strikes hitting a vehicle north of Khan Younis and a group of Palestinians in the al-Qubba area of Al-Mawasi.

media.caption: IDF strikes Gaza Strip, reportedly kills Hamas's Rafah Brigade sniper cell commander Abu Libda, Sep 10, 2026
